insight: Founded in 2021 in Seattle by David Shim, the former CEO of Foursquare; backed by Madrona and Goodwater.
name: Read AI
tagline: AI copilot that summarizes meetings, email, and messages with engagement insights.
description: Read AI captures and summarizes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams with recaps, action items, and highlights, then extends the same intelligence to email and chat. It offers Ask Read search across all conversations and an Ada digital twin that handles tasks on your behalf.
edge: Spans meetings, email and chat in one copilot, adding engagement/sentiment analytics most note-takers don't track.
